thread:
taylor-pm: Quick sync — we're trying to close the GA playbook for the Customer E2E initiative. Last pass: SLA, docs, support runbooks, monitoring alerts, and pricing examples. What's still blocking?

maria-eng: Need final signoff on SLA numbers. Ops asked for p95/p99 targets we can actually meet on Dedicated.

lee-platform: From infra tests last night: steady-state p95 ~95ms, p99 ~360ms on our target cluster for seq_len=512. With autoscale cold starts add ~200-400ms.

sasha-support: Docs/status page & runbook need owners. I can own first-line KBs but need the escalation chain documented (who to call at 3am). Also need canned replies for early GA customers.

sam-pricing: We need an example pricing table for the docs: want to show 1M tokens cost at three configs (hosted, dedicated burst, private). Do we have unit numbers to use?

jordan-analytics: Quick numbers from last week: avg token cost-hosted ~ $0.0021 per 1k tokens; Dedicated (amortized) ~ $0.0009 per 1k at steady batch. I'll prepare a small table.

maria-eng: Ops requested SLA YAML for the contract. Proposal (from eng):
```
SLA:
  availability: "99.95%"
  p95_latency_ms: 120
  p99_latency_ms: 400
  throughput: ">= 200 reqs/s per cluster (seq_len=256)"
```
If we accept those, Dedicated/Private can hit them with current autoscale config, Hosted needs routing policy to fall back to lower-cost variant under load.

lee-platform: On monitoring — dashboards ok, but we need alert runbooks for three classes: latency regressions (p99 up X%), error spike (>0.5% error rate), and capacity exhaustion (queue depth > 80%). Links: <https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/launch-playbook> (placeholder).

sasha-support: For the runbook, include quick steps: 1) check region routing 2) failover to canary model 3) bump capacity 4) page oncall. I'll draft. Also need a sample support SLA email template.

devops-bot: deploy:staging succeeded for release/2026-03-e2e (build 4521) :white_check_mark:

sam-pricing: Jordan, can you produce two pricing examples: small scale (10k reqs/month) and mid (1M reqs/month) with hosted vs dedicated math? I can draft language once I have numbers.

jordan-analytics: Will drop a spreadsheet this afternoon. Quick headline: dedicated commit reduces unit cost ~40-55% depending on batch.

maria-eng: One other gap — QA needs a signed test matrix for SLA validation (seq lengths, batch patterns, cold start vs warm). Who owns the validation doc?

lee-platform: I'll own the validation doc with QA. Plan: synthetic runs + a small pilot with 3 customers. Schedule: pilot next Tue-Fri.

sasha-support: Assign me to the pilot for support handoff. I'll prepare KB and postmortem template.

taylor-pm: Great. Action items I have: (1) Maria/Lee finalize SLA YAML and validation tests by EOD Thu; (2) Jordan deliver pricing examples by Thu; (3) Sasha draft support runbook + email templates by Fri; (4) Sam prep pricing explainer for docs once Jordan's sheet is in. Can everyone confirm? :white_check_mark: :eyes:

maria-eng: Confirmed.

lee-platform: Confirmed — validation doc first draft tomorrow.

sasha-support: Confirmed.

sam-pricing: Confirmed.

jordan-analytics: Confirmed, will upload by 1600 PT.

devops-bot: reminder: incident playbook v2 draft available at <https://confluence.redwood.internal/incident-playbook-v2>

taylor-pm: Thanks — I'll consolidate a GA checklist PR after the deliverables land and ping execs. If anything blocks the pilot schedule, call it out here ASAP. :rocket:
